[[File:Brimstone key detail.png|left|150px]]
The '''brimstone key''' can be obtained from killing monsters while on a [[Slayer task]] given by [[Konar quo Maten]]. It is used to open the [[brimstone chest]]. The average value of a drop from the brimstone chest is {{Coins|{{Average drop value|Brimstone chest|raw=yes}}}} (HA: {{Coins|{{Average drop value|Brimstone chest|raw=yes|alch=yes}}}}). Upon [[death]] in the [[Wilderness]], a brimstone key converts to two [[coins]] for the killer.

The probability of receiving a key as a drop increases with the slain monster's [[Combat level]]. For monsters with combat level 100 or higher, the probability is between <math>1/100</math> and <math>1/50</math>, capping at level 350. Specifically, the probability for a monster with combat level <math>L</math> is{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Kieren|url=https://twitter.com/JagexKieren/status/1083781544135847936|date=16 January 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106148|archivedate=26 May 2020|quote=It follows a curve up until level 100 then scales linearly between those 2 values upto level 350 combat. Creatures over thsi{{sic}} will cap at 1/50. [https://pbs.twimg.com/media/DwpdLK2W0AEynZy.jpg]}}
:<center><math>\frac{1}{120 - \left\lfloor L/5 \right\rfloor}</math></center>
For monsters with combat level <math>L</math> smaller than level 100, the probability follows the curve{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Kieren|url=https://twitter.com/JagexKieren/status/1083783815141707781|date=16 January 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/97247|archivedate=29 April 2020|quote=0.2*(CBLEVEL - 100)^2 + 100}}
:<center><math>\frac{1}{100 + \left\lfloor (100 - L)^2/5 \right\rfloor}</math></center>
Additionally, if the monster has a [[Slayer]] level requirement, there is a 20% boost in the drop probability.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1269996125387460608|date=8 June 2020|archiveurl=http://archive.is/mRtA0|archivedate=11 June 2020}}

A brimstone key is always dropped by a [[superior slayer monster]] assigned by Konar.

==Trivia==
*The symbol on the key is a taijitu which represents the concept of {{WP|Yin and yang}} ("<big>阴阳</big>"/"<big>陰陽</big>"), which, in Chinese philosophy, are the two "primal" elements which create, shape, and influence everything in existence and have to be kept in balance. This references the philosophy of the [[Kahlith]] and their masters, the [[Tasakaal]], which is to maintain the balance between life and death.
